What Is AI Search Optimization?

AI Search Optimization is the process of improving how a brand and its information are discovered, understood and represented across AI-powered search experiences.
It is also described as Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or LLM Optimization. Although the terminology is new and continues to evolve, the strongest foundations remain closely connected to SEO: technical accessibility, useful content, authority, relevance and a clearly established brand.
The service combines analysis, content, technical SEO, digital PR and measurement. It is designed to improve your potential to appear as a source, citation, mention or recommendation when users ask questions relevant to your business.

What Is an SEO Audit?

An SEO audit is a comprehensive assessment of the factors affecting a website’s visibility across traditional and AI-powered search.
It examines whether search engines can access, crawl, render, understand and index the website correctly. It also evaluates whether the content matches customer demand, whether important pages are supported through the site structure and internal linking, and whether the brand has sufficient authority and trust.
A professional audit does more than identify problems. It explains their potential consequences, finds missed opportunities and translates the analysis into prioritised actions for developers, content teams, marketers and decision-makers.
